objective: Remove the temporary raw-pointer array created when writing XDATA from shared_ptr-backed entity/table storage, while retaining complete preflight before output.

behavior: Both vector<DRW_Variant*> and vector<shared_ptr<DRW_Variant>> use the same templated non-owning validation/emission range.
The shared-pointer path no longer allocates/reserves/fills a second vector of raw pointers.
Complete value validation, XDATA group/APPID validation, and target text-encoding preflight still happen before the first EED write.

limits: Removes only the redundant shared-owner pointer array; it does not account for encoded text, binary-hex, APPID working-set allocations, allocator capacity, or peak RSS.
No full suite, peer runtime, native CAD application, or fuzz campaign was run.
